app.name: KSC Public Record Intelligence
app.tagline: Citation-first research over the public court record

language.label: Interface language
language.note: Switching changes the interface only. Document language is a property of each document.
language.provisional: Albanian legal terminology is provisional until checked against official KSC publications.

demo.description: Every figure on this screen is illustrative. In production every figure is a live read from the records database.

meaning.incident: An event alleged in the record
meaning.location: A place named in the record
meaning.organisation: A unit or body named in the record

direction.scopeNote: Direction is measured against the claim in the same row, not against any person.

provenance.boundary: Below this line: generated analysis, not the record
provenance.aiHeader: Written by software · no part of this is a court record

protection.title: Protected Witness
protection.body: This system holds only the public witness code. It stores or derives no identity attributes, and search will not resolve a name to this code.

referenceCounts.title: Record References
referenceCounts.disclaimer: How many times this appears in the record. Not a measure of significance, involvement or responsibility.

citation.unresolvedNotice: A citation on this surface could not be resolved to a page, paragraph or line range. The content that depended on it is withheld.

table.columnNote: Column values are record attributes. No column is a weight or an importance score.

states.partial: Partial data is shown. The gap is marked above.

gap.title: Not held in the public record

footer.neutrality: Every entry on this screen is a reference to the public court record. Nothing here is an assessment of any person.
footer.network: Connections represent relationships or references found in the public court record. A connection does not by itself imply wrongdoing, agreement, responsibility or guilt.
footer.referenceCounts: Reference counts state how many times something appears in the record. They are not a measure of significance, involvement or responsibility.
footer.sourceNote: Primary court sources, the database, provenance and citations are authoritative. AI output is analysis only.

placeholder.absent: This screen has not been built yet.
placeholder.reason: It is scheduled for Phase 5 — implementing the approved design with mock data. The route, chrome and language switch are live; the content is not.
placeholder.notDesigned: No artboard — built from the Evidence Explorer table pattern

home.title: KSC Public Record Intelligence
home.subtitle: Explore the public record of KSC-BC-2020-06 — documents, transcripts, witnesses, exhibits, findings — with every claim traced to its source.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search the public record — a name, W01234, F01234, P00123, ¶1204 or free text
home.statsNote: Counts will be live database reads. Until ingestion begins they render as a dash, never as zero.
home.foundationNotice: Engineering foundation. No court documents have been ingested. Every section below opens its route; content arrives in later phases.
home.principle: Primary sources → database → structured evidence → provenance and citations → search, network and analysis → AI. The record is authoritative. AI is analysis only.

phase5.mockNotice: This workspace uses clearly labelled generic demo records. No court material has been ingested.
phase5.resultOrdering: Result ordering reflects textual relevance and record density only. It carries no assessment of any person or of the weight of any evidence.
phase5.searchedVariants: The mock repository searches identifiers, titles and sample text.
phase5.commandHint: Type a name, witness code, filing, exhibit or finding
phase5.question: Question
phase5.comparisonNeutral: This workspace compares wording and source coverage. It does not assess a witness.
phase5.pathBanner: These records reference one another. That is all a path shows.
phase5.pathLimit: A shorter path is not a stronger one. Paths are ordered by hop count only.
phase5.cannotTell: What a path cannot tell you
phase5.cannotRealWorld: That the two entities are connected in any real-world sense
phase5.cannotKnowledge: That either knew of, or is answerable for, the other
phase5.cannotSignificance: That a shorter path is more significant than a longer one
phase5.canTell: That these demo documents each mention the item next to them at the citation shown
phase5.sequenceNote: Placing two cards near each other shows only that they carry nearby dates. Sequence in time is not causation.
phase5.chargeNote: As charged in the Indictment — not a determination.
phase5.noPrediction: No predictive rating or outcome estimate is produced.
phase5.legalDecline: This system does not answer legal questions. Consult qualified counsel.
phase5.simpleIntro: Plain-language explanations appear with the official wording and citations they describe.
phase5.readSource: Where can I read the source?
phase5.doesNotMean: What this finding does not mean

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.identifierMissing: No record with the identifier {identifier} is in the public set.
notFound.reason: The identifier may be mistyped, or the record may exist but not be public. Those are different states and the system distinguishes them.
notFound.generic: There is no page at this address.

phase5b.demoDescription: Generic sample {kind} row generated for layout density. No court material.
phase5b.noMatchReason: The filters below narrow the demo set the most. Remove one to widen the result.
phase5b.columnMeaning: Column values are record attributes. 'Judgment' counts paragraphs citing the exhibit — it is not a weight or an importance score.
phase5b.searchSyntax: Syntax: W##### · F##### · P##### · D##### · ¶#### · "exact phrase" · free text
phase5b.rankingDisclaimer: Result ordering reflects textual match only. It carries no assessment of any person or of the weight of any evidence.
phase5b.publicRoles: Public roles as stated in the record
phase5b.noScore: No score, rank, weight or probability about this person exists in this system.
phase5b.publicWitnessNote: Rendered only when an official public source identifies the witness.
phase5b.noPriorStatement: No prior public statement has been disclosed for this witness.
phase5b.silent: Prior statement silent on this topic.
phase5b.languageRule1: lying · dishonest · false · unreliable never appear in the system's voice.
phase5b.languageRule2: Where the Chamber made a credibility finding it is quoted, attributed and cited.
phase5b.chamberAssessment: This is the Chamber's assessment, not the system's.
phase5b.matrixNote: Direction is measured against the claim in the same row, not against any person.
phase5b.incidentFooter: Listing a person or a charge here records that the material exists — it is not an allegation by this system.
phase5b.emptyLane: No records in this layer for the selected filters
phase5b.dateMergeNote: A document's date and the date it was filed are never merged. Both are indexed separately.
phase5b.selectCard: Select a card to see every attached date.
phase5b.willNotDo: What this screen will not do
phase5b.willNot1: Predict how any court would rule.
phase5b.willNot2: Rank issues by strength or likelihood.
phase5b.legalStrip: This screen identifies questions in the record. It answers none of them and is not legal advice.
phase5b.emptyCategory: No issues surfaced in this category
phase5b.emptyCategoryReason: This reflects the pattern-matching pass over the demo set, not a judgment that none exist.
phase5b.noCitationsYet: No citations yet — every substantive sentence should resolve to a source.
phase5b.editorNote: The editor flags sentences with no supporting citation as you write. It does not evaluate whether the argument is correct.
phase5b.reviewerNote: The neutral reviewer reports gaps between the draft and the record. It does not say whether the argument should be made, nor predict how any court would receive it.
phase5b.askPlaceholder: Ask a research question about the public record
phase5b.retrievedFirst: Sources are retrieved and listed before any answer text renders.
phase5b.notAvailableBody: Closed sessions, redactions and untranslated material are reported as gaps, never filled.
phase5b.publicHero: Understand the case without simplifying the evidence.
phase5b.publicIntro: Every plain-language passage is shown together with the official text it explains, and every figure links to the public record.
phase5b.beforeBegin1: This site shows the public court record. It does not decide anything.
phase5b.beforeBegin2: Protected witnesses appear only as codes such as W01234.
phase5b.beforeBegin3: A connection between two names is a reference in the record, not an accusation.
phase5b.otherSide: There was also evidence pointing the other way
phase5b.noPathReason: No path may exist in the public record.
phase5b.citedBanner: This passage is cited by finding {ref}
phase5b.redactedPage: This page is redacted in the public version
phase5b.noContrary: No material in the record tends against this finding as stated.
phase5b.speaker: Speaker
phase5b.pendingSource: Pending — no source has been ingested
phase5b.hero: The public record, traceable to the line.
